answer: Proposal: buyers escrow a fixed pulse-imaging order for an ivory calibration target at a bridge station. Its signed capture hash lets proposed validators pay one winner per order ID, then consume it. A farm can share its model, split bids, or borrow cash to self-order; splitting adds no budget, while self-orders return their own deposit minus a burned inspection fee. Each profitable extra key needs another outside buyer's non-poolable budget. If proof is missing or the ID repeats, payout is forfeited. This replaces key-based issuance; MinePoA does not enforce it.
